description:
EU-originating journey where the disrupted leg is operated by a Star Alliance partner. SOME data has arrived (flight status showing delay) but the disruption codes are missing from the partner's data feed. DDS has partial information � knows THAT the delay occurred but not WHY. Validates that DDS handles partial partner data correctly under EU 261.

Prerequisites:
PNR: Single passenger (Reginald Thornton), 2 legs LHR?FRA?MUC. Leg 1 (LHR?FRA): AC operated, on time. Leg 2 (FRA?MUC): Operated by Lufthansa (LH). Lufthansa data received: Flight status = arrived 4hrs late (partial data). Lufthansa data missing: Disruption codes = NULL (not included in data feed). Route context: LHR = UK origin ? EU 261 applies.
